# Aurora Heating & Cooling

> Serving Aurora and the wider York Region region, Aurora Heating & Cooling is a home comfort contractor covering furnace repair, air conditioner service, ductless installation, heat pumps, fireplaces, thermostats, and duct cleaning for Ontario homeowners.

Phone: (905) 727-3184  |  Email: contact@auroraheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://auroraheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Aurora, Markham, Richmond Hill, Newmarket, Vaughan, Keswick, Stouffville, King City
